description: One-shot: subscribe, wait up to duration_ms collecting matching ticks (or until max reached), then return them. Subscriptions this call newly creates are removed afterwards. Use this for a quick 'sample N seconds of live data' request.

duration_ms.description: How long to collect, in ms. Default 3000, max 15000.

max.description: Stop early after this many frames. Default 50.

product.description: Channel: cex (crypto), dex (DEX trades), fx (forex), us (US stocks), tvl (DEX pool TVL).

name: ws_collect
title: Collect a live window
